label: Glance Clock - clear every slot
info:
Empties all eight scene slots, one at a time.

The way out when the clock is showing something you no longer have the call
for. A scene stays in its slot and replays until it is cleared, and the slot
number is exactly the thing nobody writes down.

There is a Clear All Scenes button on the device page that does the same in
one click. This is the version you can wire into a flow -- send anything into
the link-in node, or press the inject.

The delay node matters. The clock is being asked eight things in a row over
Bluetooth, and pacing them is the difference between eight cleared slots and
a connection that gives up halfway.

name: one message per slot
